dataset_split.preprocessing: TF-IDF (5,000 features, unigrams + bigrams) + 14 Handcrafted Forensic Features (FeatureUnion)
dataset_split.balancing_strategy: Applied class weighting only to the training split (never to the test split)

production_model.name: Logistic Regression
production_model.rationale: Logistic Regression is chosen for production because it outputs continuous probability distributions (predict_proba) for granular threat risk meters (0–100%) and runs at sub-millisecond inference speeds. Note: Linear SVM achieved a higher F1-Score (89.93%), while Logistic Regression achieved a higher Recall (92.31%), but Random Forest does not provide smooth linear probability calibration and Linear SVM lacks native predict_proba support.

models.name: Logistic Regression
models.description: L2-regularized linear classifier with balanced class weighting and continuous probability estimation.

models.name: Random Forest
models.description: Ensemble of 100 balanced decision trees capturing non-linear feature interactions.

models.name: Linear SVM
models.description: Maximum-margin hyperplane classifier optimized for high-dimensional sparse TF-IDF spaces.

models.name: Multinomial Naive Bayes
models.description: Probabilistic bag-of-words classifier trained with class-balanced sample weighting.
